backtest_protocol.execution_model: Signal uses only close-of-day OHLCV available on signal date. Paper entry is next available open with existing entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus replay-only USO oil-cost relief travel/leisure stock leadership paper overlay

gate3.note: No new core filter or entry rule was added. The oil-cost relief candidate source is additive default-off paper, so core signals generated/survived are unchanged from baseline.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: entry/candidate_pool: a sharp USO decline can be a same-day fuel-cost relief context; if travel/leisure equities are already outperforming SPY and USO, the market may continue repricing margin relief and demand resilience over the next sessions.

2_history_check.exp-20260428-035/036: Direct tradable ETF and ETF expansion attempts involving energy/oil proxies were rejected; this run does not trade USO/XLE and uses USO only as non-traded cost context.
2_history_check.exp-20260504-045/exp-20260511-024/exp-20: USO/XLE continuation, pair confirmation, and energy-risk allocation neighbors failed. This run tests the opposite economic channel: oil down as a cost relief signal for fuel-sensitive stock leaders.
2_history_check.exp-20260607-018: VIXY volatility-relief stock leadership succeeded as a bounded relation alpha; this run borrows the relation shape but replaces volatility relief with oil-cost relief.

gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md three canonical windows. Accept only if aggregate EV/PnL improve, no EV/PnL regression window, target sample >=20 across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, and concentration guard passes. A positive replay still requires shared adapter parity before promotion.

hypothesis: USO oil-cost relief may identify fuel-sensitive travel and leisure stock leaders with next-open continuation as a distinct free-OHLCV cost-relief relation.
interpretation: The USO oil-cost relief travel/leisure leadership source did not clear Gate 4; do not promote or locally retune this oil-cost relation on the frozen windows.
negative_reflection: If rejected, the likely reason is that USO oil declines are too noisy as a next-open equity catalyst, travel/leisure leadership is broad beta rather than fuel-cost pass-through, or airlines and travel names are dominated by idiosyncratic demand/capacity/news risks. Do not retry by sweeping USO return, close-location, target industries, top-N, hold-day, cooldown, or notional thresholds on these frozen windows.
next_evidence_needed: A positive replay lead still needs a shared default-off adapter and parity tests before production observation. A retry after rejection needs materially new PIT evidence such as jet-fuel crack spread, airline fuel-cost sensitivity, capacity/demand context, or closed forward rows.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping USO return, USO close-location, USO-vs-SPY spread, travel/leisure industry membership, stock leadership, volume, volatility, hold-day, top-N, cooldown, or paper notional on the same frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A retry requires materially new PIT cost-relief evidence such as jet fuel crack spread, airline fuel-cost sensitivity, airline capacity/demand context, route exposure, or closed forward replacement-value rows.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: Gate 4 observed 63 target trades; old_thin changed by -0.0106 EV and $-443.97. If rejected, the after-cost next-open edge was either too noisy, not causally connected to future fuel-sensitive equity returns, or overwhelmed by airline/travel demand and company-specific risks.

prediction.confidence_reason: Accepted macro and volatility-relief relation alphas support non-traded context signals, but rejected USO/XLE ETF trials warn that oil signals often relabel sector beta unless mapped to a specific fuel-cost beneficiary pool.

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result would require a shared default-off adapter that computes the same USO oil-cost relief context, fuel-sensitive industry membership, liquid stock leadership fields, same-ticker core-overlap exclusion, next-open paper entry, 10-trading-day exit, costs, cooldown, top-N limit, and concentration controls in both replay and daily production before any report queue, paper ledger, candidate priority, sizing, watchlist, or order surface could change.
